makeup_bare.label: 不加彩妆
makeup_bare.promptEn: No visible colour cosmetics; retain the selected skin texture and facial features.
perceptualWarnings: 不加彩妆不等于幼态、无瑕皮肤或改变年龄

makeup_skin_sheer.label: 轻透原肤感
makeup_skin_sheer.promptEn: Sheer complexion coverage matched to the existing skin colour; natural skin texture remains visible.
perceptualWarnings: 薄遮盖仍可能改变肤色均匀度和年龄观感

makeup_satin_medium.label: 缎光中遮盖
makeup_satin_medium.promptEn: Medium-coverage complexion makeup in the existing skin colour, with a satin finish.

makeup_matte_full.label: 哑光全遮盖
makeup_matte_full.promptEn: Full-coverage matte complexion makeup matched to the existing skin colour.
perceptualWarnings: 可能遮盖雀斑、斑点等识别线索；是否保留须单独指定

brows_hair_strokes.label: 眉毛：根根描画
brows_hair_strokes.promptEn: Fine hairlike brow strokes following the existing brow shape and direction.

brows_soft_powder.label: 眉毛：柔雾填充
brows_soft_powder.promptEn: Soft powder-filled eyebrows with diffused edges, following the existing brow placement.

brows_brushed_up.label: 眉毛：上梳毛流
brows_brushed_up.promptEn: Brow hairs brushed upward and outward with visible separated texture.
perceptualWarnings: 梳理后的轮廓可能改变眉眼距离观感

eye_short_wing.label: 眼妆：短尾上扬眼线
eye_short_wing.promptEn: A thin upper-lash line ending in a short upward outer flick; separated lashes.
perceptualWarnings: 指眼线绘制方向，不是改变眼裂倾斜角

eye_long_wing.label: 眼妆：横向延展眼线
eye_long_wing.promptEn: An extended cosmetic outer eyeliner wing, retaining the underlying eyelid anatomy.
perceptualWarnings: 可能产生更长眼形的观感；模型也可能误改眼裂

eye_soft_smoke.label: 眼妆：柔边烟熏
eye_soft_smoke.promptEn: Soft charcoal-brown shading around the lash lines, diffused outward without a hard edge.
perceptualWarnings: 眼周深色可能影响眼窝深浅和眼睛大小观感

blush_apples.label: 腮红：面颊中央晕染
blush_apples.promptEn: Soft blush concentrated on the apples of the cheeks, with diffused edges.

blush_temple.label: 腮红：颧外侧至太阳穴
blush_temple.promptEn: Blush placed in a soft C-shaped arc from the outer cheekbone toward the temple.
perceptualWarnings: 位置是色彩分布，不是移动颧骨

contour_soft.label: 修容：浅淡颧下阴影
contour_soft.promptEn: Subtle painted shading beneath the cheekbones with softly blended cheekbone highlights.
perceptualWarnings: 可能强化骨骼观感；不得将结构字段改为窄脸或高颧骨

lips_stain.label: 唇妆：轻透染色
lips_stain.promptEn: Sheer lip stain following the existing vermilion border.

lips_red_matte.label: 唇妆：清晰红色哑光
lips_red_matte.promptEn: Matte red lip colour with a crisp edge following the existing lip outline.

lips_ombre.label: 唇妆：深边浅心渐层
lips_ombre.promptEn: A darker lip perimeter blended toward a lighter centre, following the existing lip outline.
perceptualWarnings: 明暗渐层可能改变唇部体积观感，无须真实加厚嘴唇

trend_light_dewy_2025.label: 轻透水光组合（Clean girl 别名）
trend_light_dewy_2025.promptEn: Light dewy complexion coverage, brushed-up textured brows, subtle cheek blush and natural-colour glossy lips.
perceptualWarnings: 历史/社媒别名仅作检索，不代表卫生、阶层或人格
不自动改变发型、年龄、肤色

trend_sunset_2025.label: 橙粉落日腮红（2025 配方）
trend_sunset_2025.promptEn: Watercolour-like blended pink and orange cheek colour with a soft golden highlight and a glossy coral-toned lip.

historical_quant_1966.label: 1960年代伦敦眼部重点（启发式）
historical_quant_1966.promptEn: A 1960s London-inspired eye-focused makeup interpretation, restrained complexion and lip colour, visibly emphasized eyelashes.
perceptualWarnings: 源文确证眼部重点，不将一种广告妆等同整个年代
不自动漂白肤色；完整复原需具体参考图

historical_1920s_cinema.label: 1920年代美国银幕启发妆
historical_1920s_cinema.promptEn: A 1920s American cinema-inspired interpretation with visible mascara, eyeliner, dusky eyeshadow and defined lipstick.
perceptualWarnings: 不把某类银幕妆当作所有女性的日常
唇形与细眉若无特定参考，不自动套用

historical_kohl_inspired.label: 古埃及眼妆启发：黑色描边
historical_kohl_inspired.promptEn: Ancient-Egyptian-inspired dark kohl-like cosmetic outlining around the eyes and darkened lashes.
perceptualWarnings: 只引用有证据的黑色眼部描绘；不自动加金色眼影、王冠、肤色或族裔
不是任何特定法老或年代的精确复原

arimino_2026.region: Japan; collection exists, geometry not extracted from text

dpm_luoji.date: 清代图像；馆方讨论唐代先例

nfm_joseon.title: 国立民俗博物馆：朝鲜时代发型趋势

smithsonian_black_hair.title: NMAAHC: Strands of Inspiration
smithsonian_black_hair.region: Black cultural histories; no single continental uniform hairstyle

india_braiding.title: NGMA Bengaluru: Toilet, S. Dhanpal
india_braiding.region: India; domestic braiding evidence, not ancient attribution

bm_egypt_wig.title: British Museum EA2560
bm_egypt_wig.region: Egypt; object likely male, not generic female preset

kryolan_base.title: Kryolan: Foundations
kryolan_base.supports: Coverage, consistency and finish are separable product properties.

kryolan_contour.title: Kryolan: Highlight and contouring techniques
kryolan_contour.supports: Shadow/highlight placement and underpainting are cosmetic techniques, not bone edits.

nars_blush.title: NARS: Blush application and placement
nars_blush.supports: Apple, temple C-shape and cheekbone placements; matte/satin/shimmer finish.

abh_brows.title: Anastasia Beverly Hills: Brows
abh_brows.supports: Fill, hairlike detail, highlight and grooming are distinct controls. Golden-ratio marketing is not adopted as a biological ideal.

maybelline_wing.title: Maybelline: How to do winged eyeliner
maybelline_wing.supports: Upper outer flick, lower-lash treatment and line geometry.

mac_lips.title: MAC: Lip textures and treatments
mac_lips.supports: Gloss, matte, stain, metallic and ombre are distinct lip treatments.

mac_ombre.title: MAC pro artist: Brown ombre lips
mac_ombre.supports: Darker perimeter and lighter center can follow existing lip boundary.

clean_2025.title: Maybelline UK: Clean girl makeup
clean_2025.supports: A brand-specific light/dewy, feathered-brow, glossy-lip recipe, not a universal current definition.

sunset_2025.title: MAC: Sunset Spritz
sunset_2025.supports: Orange/pink/golden cheek and lip palette with blended ombre colour.

quant_1966.title: V&A: The story of Mary Quant make-up
quant_1966.supports: 1966 London context; relatively understated face/lips and eye emphasis; interchangeable coordinated colours.

usa_1920s.title: Smithsonian National Museum of American History: Make-up
usa_1920s.supports: 1920s US urban/cinema-associated visible mascara, liner, dark shadow and lipstick; not a whole decade universal uniform.

egypt_kohl.title: British Museum: Looking good in ancient Egypt
egypt_kohl.supports: Men and women used black kohl around eyes and to darken eyelashes; does not establish every modern Cleopatra design.

kabuki.title: Japan Arts Council: Kabuki stock characters and makeup
kabuki.supports: Role-specific painted colour/line conventions; not everyday Japanese cosmetics or ethnicity.

age_makeup.title: Russell et al: Differential effects of makeup on perceived age
age_makeup.supports: In studied photographs, effect differs by age group; makeup is not uniformly age-reducing. No image-model evaluation.

facs.title: Paul Ekman Group: Facial Action Coding System
facs.supports: Describe visible movements as components rather than inferring character or mental state.

age_skin.title: US National Institute on Aging: Skin care and aging
age_skin.supports: Age appearance involves skin texture, elasticity and fullness, with substantial individual variation.
